briefdescription.para: \Returns the Use edge that corresponds to OpIdx.

detaileddescription.para: Note: This is the default implementation that works for instructions that match the underlying LLVM instruction. All others should use a different implementation.

briefdescription.para: \Returns the Use for the OpIdx'th operand.

detaileddescription.para: This is virtual to allow instructions to deviate from the LLVM IR operands, which is a requirement for sandboxir Instructions that consist of more than one LLVM Instruction.

briefdescription.para: The default implementation works only for single-LLVMIR-instruction Users and only if they match exactly the LLVM instruction.

detaileddescription.para: NOTE: This should also work for OpIdx == getNumOperands(), which is used for op_end().

briefdescription.para: Replaces any operands that match FromV with ToV.

detaileddescription.para: Returns whether any operands were replaced.

briefdescription.para: Should crash if there is something wrong with the instruction.
